headline: Observed Qualcomm Toronto internship offers possible SV modeling and AMS validation assignments
fact: As observed November 7, Qualcomm advertised a Toronto Analog Design internship for 12 or 16 months beginning in May or June 2027. Possible assignments include SystemVerilog analog behavioral models, AMS co-simulation to validate them, simulation-data peer review and testbench-performance metrics, with analog, digital, firmware and system teams. The application feeds multiple project-specific roles, so these are possible duties rather than completed work or a promise that every intern receives the same assignment. The Event uses the observation date because a reliable first-publication date is unconfirmed; 2027 is the planned placement year.

sources.title: Qualcomm employer LinkedIn: FY27 Analog Design Internship, Canada
sources.summary: Employer-attributed full text identifies the Toronto Analog Design team, possible SV/AMS validation and review duties, candidate-pool model and May/June 2027 start. Only mutable relative posting age was available; this check is not evidence of a new November posting.
